summary: 1. DR-343 posts a second consecutive clean day (Aug 10), confirming recovery from its 29-Jul Drifter Failure — the 86th pass had flagged this tentative pending a second clean day, and Aug 10 delivers it, closing the standing-fault entry this article has carried since 29-Jul. 2. 2. WT-114 and WT-300, both opened late on 9-Aug, cross into a full 24-hr down day on Aug 10 with no Date Out on either — no longer same-cycle churn, now standing faults to watch alongside EX-123, EX-253, WD-145, and MG-266, all four of which remain down unchanged. 3. 3. Two new faults open: DT-365 pulled for a tyre change-out (6.25% avail, no Date Out) and WL-295 "Bucket Pin Noise" (33.33% avail, closed same day) — the latter is the main driver behind the Wheel Loader fleet's drop from 93.13% to 85.83% day over day. 4. Overall daily availability holds roughly flat (84.81% to 84.91%), MTD ticks up (82.81% to 83.02%), core fleet daily improves slightly (76.82% to 77.50%) — no material shift in the fleet-wide picture despite the individual unit moves above. 5. DT-108, DT-109, DT-282, and DT-346 are all itemized down by name in this report, the same four-truck grouping the 85th pass's discrepancy tracking has been watching since Week 32-33 — DT-281 itself shows only a routine 500H service window, not a fault. 6. No other production-data files (Client Meeting Report, DPR, A&U, Block Info, Drill Meters, Drill Sampling, survey workbooks) changed since the 86th pass — nothing to update on [[daily-production-report]] or [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] this pass. 7. Articles updated (`Last updated` unchanged at 2026-08-11, same calendar day as the 86th pass): [[fleet-availability-utilization]] (Aug 10 dated section, DR-343 moved off the standing-fault register, WT-114/WT-300 status update, new DT-365/WL-295 faults, two Open Questions resolved/updated from the 86th pass, one new Open Question added). 8. This is a dashboard-scoped run (per the 74th/75th/77th/80th/82nd pass pattern) — Important References and the Task Feedback Log were not processed. 9. No content removed or renamed. ---
